MeVX, a non-custodial, multi-chain trading terminal focused on on-chain assets and meme-asset trading.

MeVX has ~2M users and $8M in sticky deposits. The platform supports Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain and Base, and has established Vietnamese-language operations as a base for broader Southeast Asian expansion.
A definitive agreement is expected within the next 12 months.
The stock price dropped about 4% on Wednesday during pre-market trade.

title: Zhibao Technology to acquire crypto trading platform MeVX
